chunks: And Kirdīn narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever gives charity in the morning, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, will avert the misfortune of that day from him."
ai.seo_question: How does giving charity in the morning protect a person during the day?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of giving charity at the start of the day. It indicates that morning charity is a means by which Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, repels the ill fortune of that day from the giver.
